title: Rich items
text: Actions with icons, descriptions, shortcut hints, danger tone, and nested submenus.

title: Checkbox and radio
text: Toggle and choice items keep their state and report it on selection.

title: Keyboard and typeahead
text: Arrow keys, Home, End, and typed letters move focus as users expect.

title: Smart placement
text: Opens next to its trigger and flips or shifts to stay inside the viewport.
